verdict.rationale: vLLM is a server/library that can be installed via pip/uv, run as a CLI-launched OpenAI-compatible API server, run offline via Python scripts, and has an official Docker image — all consistent with headless/CI automation use. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, no mention of exit codes, health checks, or CI pipeline examples, and no independent evidence of it being used in automated pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guides, health-check/readiness endpoints documentation, independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
